newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight rates fall as market eases.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight rates fall as market eases.

text.p: Private and public sector interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell slightly on Wednesday as the market became more liquid, bankers said.
They said overnight rates slipped to between 10 3/16 and 10 5/16 percent from 10 1/2 and 10 3/4 percent on Tuesday.

One-week rates also fell slightly to between 10 1/4 and 10 9/16 percent from 10 1/2 and 10 3/4. Public sector banks resumed lending at their normal rate of 10 1/2 percent after some had asked for rates of about 11 percent a few days ago.
